full_judgment:
Syed Mahmud Hossain J: This criminal petition for leave to appeal is directed against the judgment and order dated 16-05-2010 passed by a Division Bench of the High Court Division in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 8044 of 2007 out of arising proceeding of Lohagara Police Station Case No.19 (4)2007 corresponding to GR No. 93 of 2007 under Sections 143/342/447/385/379/380427/506 of the Penal Code now pending in the Court of Magistrate, First Class, Sadar, Chittagong. 

 2. The facts, leading to the filing of this petition, in short, are: On 24-04-2007, one Md. Elias Sharif, opposite-party No. 2, as the informant lodged a First Information Report (FIR) against the accused-petitioners, alleging, inter alia, that on 18-01-2004, accused-petitioner Nos. 1, 6 and 7 called him away from his hotel and accused-petitioner No. 1 demanded Taka two lacs as subscription for their party office. After that, on 21-2-2004 under the direction of accused-petitioner No. 1, accused-petitioner Nos. 2-6, 8 and 9 had detained the informant at gun point and looted an amount of Taka 27,322 as well as other goods worth about Taka 5,35,007. On receipt of the FIR by the Lohagara Police Station, Lohagara PS Case No.19 (4) 2007 was recorded against the accused-petitioners under sections 143/343/447/385/379/380/427 and 506 of the Penal Code, from which GR No.93 of 2007 has arisen. 

 12. In this connection, it is important to note that the High Court Division was misled by the inquiry report of police in which there is a reference of PS Case No.12(5)2000 under sections 323/379/506 of the Penal Code which has no connection with PS Case No.19(4)2007 under sections 143/342/447/385/379/380427/ 506 of the Penal Code and also with the petition of complaint dated 13-9-2004 which was sent by the learned Magistrate to Lohagara Police Station for inquiry on 13-9-2004.
